notes: Explore idea: ordinal regression (proportional odds / ordered logit, ordered probit, Brant 1990 test with per-cut slopes) as a research-algorithm tool, ventures/ordinal-regression. 0 of 1,414 venture READMEs mentioned ordinal/ordered logistic regression, proportional odds, polr or Brant. Verified against statsmodels 0.15.0 OrderedModel (loglik within 3e-12 on wine, simulated Likert survey and a planted non-PO set, both links; coefs ~1e-8; SEs ~2e-6 because statsmodels uses a numerical Hessian) and a numpy Brant implementation (5e-11); Brant size 6.0% at 5% on 400 PO simulations. Example: UCI Wine Quality red (CC BY 4.0): alcohol OR 2.43 per %, Brant rejects PO (92.8 on 24 df), alcohol slope 0.28 at the 4|5 cut vs ~1 elsewhere. Local checks: run_workflow_locally --for-changes 12/14 workflows, the 2 failures (sibling links, hero lede) fixed and their tests rerun green; unwired_checks 241/241; venture tests 40 pass; headless Chromium no console errors, no external requests, no overflow at 380px. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README and research-tools candidates line carry what the next run needs.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
